== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Karoshan Alliance]] is one of the four major regions of the galaxy, representing the smallest territory among the primary powers. It is composed of the [[Karoshan Empire]], the [[Visiria system]], and several other smaller systems. Despite its limited size, it remains a significant force in the galaxy. The [[Visiri]] people serve as a prominent member of this coalition, acting as its secondary power. Alliance space is highly developed and civilized, featuring a dense network of stations, colonies, and ships across its many planets. The region's borders extend to the edge of [[Dark Space]], with specific systems like [[Fifty-Three X]] marking its limits. The Alliance maintains a tense relationship with the [[Galactic Union]], and its territory is subject to various political and military maneuvers involving other galactic entities.}}
